meta.title: Session manager
meta.description: Lists every session by workspace in Settings > Session manager, with a lock toggle, a move-to-workspace picker, and a delete button on each row. Each workspace shows 5 sessions by default and folds the rest behind a Show the remaining N row that expands in place; both that count (1-200) and an optional only-active-within-K-days filter (0 = off, stacked with the count) live under List display. Deleting asks for confirmation first, then moves the session into a recycle bin at the bottom of the page and out of the workspace list for good: the log file is moved into the recycle bin, so the session stays invisible even with archived sessions shown. Restore brings it back exactly as it was during a configurable window (24 hours by default, 0 deletes for good immediately). The picker moves a session to another workspace, which really relocates the log folder on disk and rewrites the session header's cwd; when the system refuses a file operation the panel lists every step and both real paths first, and you choose between retrying and changing the registration only. Locked sessions can be neither deleted nor moved, and both refusals come from the Host rather than from a disabled button.
